name: generic_axes_diagram
description: Any single-panel curve diagram that is not a supply/demand market: production functions, utility curves, cost curves, dose-response, diminishing returns. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET — compose it with tier-2 elements instead: an axes element with the right labels, curve elements (qualitative direction/curvature/steepness, or an expr like '80*(1 - exp(-0.05*x))' for diminishing marginal returns), optional point elements, and labels attached to the curves.
